compiler_only_output.reason: InitResources, HurtPlayer, UpdateGroundCollision, State1, State3, State5 and AdvancePath declare Vector3 locals, so this TU re-emits Vector3's vague-linkage D1 alongside its own text. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0 and an enrolled source already owns it; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

notes: The class name daBgSnmBdy_c and the profile ID BIG_SNOWMAN_BODY survive in the cartridge. The coined spelling SnowmanBody that this tree previously carried has no cartridge attestation and was retired in the same change: ov072 0x0212278c holds the length-prefixed _ZTS payload "12daBgSnmBdy_c", _ZTI12daBgSnmBdy_c at 0x02122780 points its +4 word at it, and the vtable's -4 header word points back at that _ZTI. Both _ZTV11SnowmanBody and _ZTV12daBgSnmBdy_c sat at 0x021227c0 in ov072/symbols.txt; the coined alias is dropped because dsd resolves .data records by NAME and exactly one spelling may survive.

daBgSnmBdy_c_classInit, g_profile_BIG_SNOWMAN_BODY and the promoted path src/game/actors/d_a_bg_snm_bdy.cpp are source-style reconstructions supported by the registry relationship and later EAD conventions, not recovered identifiers. Historical aliases: SnowmanBody_Spawn and SnowmanBody_SpawnInfo.

The full factory join is a tested reconstruction hypothesis backed by direct registry and constructor evidence; build/tu_map.json stops the run at 0x0211fedc and does not itself label that one-function run as daBgSnmBdy_c.

The typed 0x1c profile follows its actual consumers: fBase_c reads behavior/render priorities at +0x04/+0x06; dActor_c reads actor flags at +0x08 and passes +0x0c/+0x10/+0x14/+0x18 to SetRanges as clip offset Y, clip radius, clip distance and far distance. The existing signed halfwords, scalar types, order and unchanged retail values 0x0112, 0x0085, 2, 0x82000, 0x82000, 0x01000000 and 0x01000000 are preserved. Field names describe observed use; the original declaration spelling and signedness are not recovered.

The inline destructor declared last makes mwccarm emit the exact D1 then D0 pair at the bottom of the run with no D2 body. The class-local operator new routes an ordinary `new daBgSnmBdy_c()` to the retail fBase_c allocator; the compiler emits and owns the vptr store, so no _ZTV address is spelled by hand in the source.

State<N>/InitState<N> are coined member names that claim the PMF table INDEX and nothing more. The static initializer at 0x02122018 copies twelve pointer-to-member constants into data_ov072_02122b64 in those pairs; SetState indexes it at state * 0x10, CallStateInit invokes the first of the pair and CallStateBehavior the second. The cartridge carries no descriptive identifier for any of them.

IsPlayerNearCenter, UpdateRollAngle, AdvancePath, HurtPlayer, UpdateGroundCollision, UpdateModel, CallStateInit, CallStateBehavior and SetState are truthful inferred private spellings. Their class ownership, inbound calls, bodies, relocations and codegen are proven; the exact original English names are not. UpdateGroundCollision's mangled spelling asserts a POINTER parameter (P10dBgCh_Actr); the bytes cannot distinguish a pointer from a reference here, and R10dBgCh_Actr would have matched equally well. SetState's Ei suffix chooses int for the state index; the table access and call sites do not establish the original parameter type or rule out an enum. The int spelling is inferred, not a recovered identifier or type.

Legacy per-function contribution comparison is not applicable to the final lifecycle form: the two old out-of-line destructor shards cannot compile beside the inline destructor that emits their exact replacements. The ordinary intact-object linkcheck is the production proof.

Substantial reconstruction work remains. Recounted at adopted input dc12411cff6a88cb2789e6ded97df809b499c9e3 with tiers.py's RAW_OFFSET regex: 18 of 26 out-of-line member definitions contain its raw-offset pattern, 154 occurrences across 117 source lines. The separate factory makes 27 out-of-line definitions total; the inline destructor emits the other two of the 29 function symbols. The previous report's 639 source lines were a historical snapshot; that input has 642. The TU still spells other modules' mangled symbols directly instead of calling declared C++ methods. Promotion is a packaging state, not a finished reconstruction.

Historical leftover cleanup substituted named fields and already-declared methods (LoadFile/SetFile/FromID/UpdatePos/FindWithID/FindWithActorID/IsOnGround/JustHitGround/CopyNormalTo/StartTalk/ShowMessage/GetTalkState, mShadowMat = IDENTITY_MATRIX4X3 with common.h first, State3 daBgSnmHed_c::unk_336 via include/daBgSnmHed_c.h). That historical pass recorded these remaining interfaces and alternate spellings: 6az Init/SetRanges/DropShadowRadHeight/Earthquake/RunningSlidingDustAt/Func_02015560/Player::Hurt; dBgCh_Actr::Init header Fix12i vs ROM Fix12<int>; UpdateContinuous veneer; GetFloorResult not in the header; func_0203568c/84; func_0201267c; Sound::PlayLong; data_ov072_* handles; AdvancePath c+off (named members 29-word DIFF, GetNode/NumNodes methods 14-word DIFF); State1/State3 (int)this+0x3a2 mSubstate++ (named form size-DIFFs); (long long)(int) on mScaleX/mRadius. Including daBgSnmHed_c.h stops mwccarm emitting unused Matrix4x3 D1; compiler_only_output keeps only Vector3 D1.

The native-vector continuation replaces four int[3] stack stand-ins with real Vector3 locals in State1, State5 and AdvancePath. UpdateGroundCollision uses the already-declared const GetFloorResult method and the actual borrowed dBgPi.surface, rather than a char pointer plus four-byte view. The local scalar Player::Hurt bridge now agrees with the current int(Player*, void*, u32, int, u8, u8, u8) definition and preserves the discarded result and all argument values. Existing flat actor/home coordinates, raw AdvancePath fields, matrix-copy form, native PMF/state return contracts and other fixed-point scalar bridges remain partial reconstruction under issue2476. The earlier GetFloorResult-not-declared and int[3]-node descriptions are historical, not current constraints. The current compilation emits the existing Vector3 D1 earlier; its body, attributes and canonical duplicate policy are unchanged. No new storage, helper admission, canonical home, enrollment or shared-header change is made. Current exact proof is recorded separately in notes/experiments/snmbdy-native-vectors1015.json; the older verification block retains its original historical pin.

Static initializer folded: the model handle, the six-row state table and the two Vector3 course points are real definitions in d_a_bg_snm_bdy.cpp, replacing the handwritten src/unnamed/ov072/__sinit_ov072_02122018.c. mwcc emits __sinit_d_a_bg_snm_bdy.cpp (0x1e0), its .ctor word, the twelve PMF literals and the three registration nodes itself; all are byte- and relocation-identical to retail. Ownership: ov072 .ctor words run in .text TU order (0x02122710 is d_a_bg_snwmn's, 0x02122714 d_a_pg_bby's), so 0x02122708 and 0x0212270c are the body's and the head's; this initializer constructs asset 0x2ad (big_snowman_body.bmd) and fills the PMF table that only this TU's SetState reads.
